terms.comment: Our adverb, formed like Latīnē and Traupman’s Anglicē (p. 33) from Lūsitānicus, Morgan–Owens’s adjective for Portuguese. No reference work has the adverb itself.

sources: Our formation, on the model of Latīnē.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 33.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Portuguese.
